theorem lg_target {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {x : K} {m n : ℕ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h'x : x < 1) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := by
  induction' n using nat.strong_induction_on with d h
  · exact le_refl (x^m / (1 - x))
  · have h1 : 0 < 1 - x := by rw [sub_lt_iff_add_gt]; exact (hx.trans h'x)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ x ^ m := pow_nonneg hx m
    have h3 : 0 ≤ 1 - x := by rw [sub_nonneg]; exact h1
    have h4 : 0 ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := div_nonneg h2 h3
    have h5 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m d, x ^ i ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := h d h1 h2 h3 h4
    have h6 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m (d + 1), x ^ i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m d, x ^ i + x ^ d := by rfl
    have h7 : x ^ d ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; exact (mul_le_of_forall_lt_of_nonneg (by simp) (by simp) (λ a' : ℕ, λ h_a : a' < x, λ b' : ℕ, λ h_b : b' < m, (pow_lt_pow hx h_a).trans (pow_lt_pow hx h_b).trans (mul_lt_mul_right h1 (pow_lt_pow hx h_b))))
    have h8 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m (d + 1), x ^ i ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := add_le_add_left h5 h7
    exact h8
